title: Database Lock Contention from Long-Running Analytics Query
description: An analytics team ran a long-running ad-hoc query (full table scan on orders) that held locks blocking all order-service writes. Order service shows deadlock errors and timeouts. The query was started manually, not via deployment.
initial_symptoms: Database shows long-running query on orders table

evidence_catalog.summary: Deadlock count spiked from 0 to 50/min at 15:00 UTC
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT deadlock_count FROM db_metrics WHERE service='order-service'

evidence_catalog.summary: Order service logs: 'Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction'
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE service='order-service' AND message LIKE '%Deadlock%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate deadlock error logs

evidence_catalog.summary: pg_stat_activity shows long-running query: 'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at > ...' running for 15min, holding locks
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' AND query LIKE '%FROM orders%'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate pg_stat_activity with long query

evidence_catalog.summary: Long-running query originated from analytics-tool (application_name), user 'analytics-engineer-1'
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT application_name, usename FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=<long_query_pid>
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will simulate query origin identification
Phase 1/2 will create empty deployment list

causal_chain.from_description: Ad-hoc analytics query (full table scan on orders) started manually
causal_chain.to_description: Query holds locks on orders table, blocking all writes; causes deadlocks on concurrent writes

causal_chain.from_description: Order service writes block on locks, eventually deadlock
causal_chain.to_description: Deadlock errors, write latency spikes to 30s
Orders cannot be placed; revenue impact

contributing_factors: No query timeout for ad-hoc queries
Analytics team has direct production DB access

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Deadlock errors appear in order-service (but caused by external query)
No recent deployment (but manual query caused it)

required_checks.expected_outcome: Long-running SELECT on orders table from analytics-tool

required_checks.description: Kill long-running query and observe recovery
required_checks.expected_outcome: Deadlocks stop immediately after query killed

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Kill long-running query; revoke direct production DB access for analytics; provide read replica; add query timeout
test_plan: Set up read replica for analytics
